from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import hashlib,json
from src.tools.t01_partition import audited_result
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
name='diag_test_s16_s03_independent_summary_01'
path=root/'results/t01v2_checkpoint_test_s16_s03_01.json'
checkpoint,reference=audited_result(path)
m=checkpoint['metrics']
assert checkpoint['_meta']['exit_code']==0 and m['errors']==[] and m['status']=='checkpoint_ready_for_human_review'
kinds=['direct_flip','direct_stay','look_flip','look_stay']
split={k:{'true':0,'false':0} for k in kinds}
entries=[]
for row in m['candidate_pairs']:
 flag=row['independent_verification']['passes_original_physics_rule']
 assert type(flag) is bool
 split[row['kind']]['true' if flag else 'false']+=1
 entries.append({k:row[k] for k in ['pair_id','scene','kind','pair_reference','source_file','proposal_identity','review_image']}|{'passes_original_physics_rule':flag})
assert {k:sum(v.values()) for k,v in split.items()}==m['published_by_class']
for image in m['review_files']:
 for ref in [image,image['source_image']]:
  b=(root/ref['file']).read_bytes()
  assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==ref['sha256']
source_summaries=[]
classified=Counter()
unknown_look=0
for source in checkpoint['sources']:
 p=root/source['file'];b=p.read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==source['sha256']
 d=json.loads(b);s=d['metrics']
 journal=s['attempt_journal']
 filename=journal['file'] if isinstance(journal,dict) else journal
 p=root/filename;b=p.read_bytes()
 expected=s.get('attempt_journal_sha256') or (journal.get('sha256') if isinstance(journal,dict) else None)
 assert expected and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==expected
 rows=[json.loads(line) for line in b.splitlines() if line.strip()]
 reasons=Counter();classified_rows=0;unclassified=0
 for row in rows:
  if row.get('kind')=='look_stay' and row.get('status')!='passed':
   classified_rows+=1
   reasons.update(row.get('discard_reasons') or ['reason_not_recorded'])
  if row.get('proposed_pool')=='look' and row.get('kind') is None:
   unclassified+=1
 classified.update(reasons);unknown_look+=unclassified
 source_summaries.append({'source':source,'scene':d['config']['scene'],'status':s['status'],
  'original_error':s.get('error'),'cleanup_errors':s['cleanup_errors'],
  'classified_look_stay_rejected_attempts':classified_rows,
  'classified_look_stay_rejection_counts':dict(reasons),
  'unclassified_look_pool_attempts':unclassified,
  'original_counted_by_proposed_pool_mode':s.get('g01_collection',{}).get('counted_by_proposed_pool_mode'),
  'original_look_pool_summary':s.get('proposed_pool_attempts',{}).get('look'),
  'original_all_mode_rejection_counts':s['discard_reason_counts'],
  'attempt_journal':{'file':filename,'sha256':expected}})
report={'scope':'Original independent construction checkpoint only; not T02/cache/training acceptance. No rule or source changed.',
 'checkpoint':reference,'independent_by_original_physics_rule':split,'pairs':entries,
 'review_files':m['review_files'],'source_summaries':source_summaries,
 'classified_look_stay_rejection_counts':dict(classified),
 'unclassified_look_pool_attempts':unknown_look,
 'rejection_scope':'Reasons are counted only for journal rows already classified look_stay. Earlier unclassified failures remain unknown for actual class. Original Look-pool aggregates include Flip and Stay; proposal-mode counts are preserved separately and are not used to invent class-specific reasons.',
 'original_errors':m['errors'],'original_duplicates':m['duplicate_pairs']}
directory=root/'logs/review'/name;directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
with (directory/'report.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(report,f,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False);f.write('\n')
lines=['# S03 independent construction check','',report['scope'],'',
 '| Class | Original physics true | Original physics false |','|---|---:|---:|']
lines += [f"| {k} | {split[k]['true']} | {split[k]['false']} |" for k in kinds]
lines += ['',report['rejection_scope'],'','Classified LookStay rejection reasons: '+json.dumps(dict(classified),ensure_ascii=False),
 'Unclassified Look-pool attempts: '+str(unknown_look),'','Original review files:']
lines += ['- '+x['file']+' ('+x['pair_id']+')' for x in m['review_files']]
with (directory/'report.md').open('x') as f:f.write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
r=directory/'report.json'
print('S16_S03_INDEPENDENT_SUMMARY_JSON: '+json.dumps({'report':{'file':str(r.relative_to(root)),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},'independent_by_original_physics_rule':split,'classified_look_stay_rejection_counts':dict(classified),'unclassified_look_pool_attempts':unknown_look,'review_files':m['review_files']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
